For any $\mathscr{F}$ in $D^{\mathrm{b}}_{\mathscr{S}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathbf{k})$ and any $n\in\mathbf{Z}$ we have

$\mathsf{H}_{c}^{n+\langle 2\rho,\mu\rangle}(S_{\mu},\mathscr{F})\cong\mathsf{F}_{\mu}({}^{p}\hskip-1.0pt\mathscr{H}^{n}(\mathscr{F})).$

10.2 Equivariant and constructible perverse sheaves

Now we can prove that Corollary 4.8 is still true in this context (but for more serious reasons). By definition, the forgetful functor $D^{\mathrm{b}}_{c,{G_{\mathcal{O}}}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathbf{k})\to D^{\mathrm{b}}_{\mathscr{S}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathbf{k})$ is t-exact for the perverse t-structures. In the following proposition we consider the restriction of this functor to perverse sheaves.
card.label: Lemma 10.7

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
